journey.start_rule: client_start_date (Jira): for issues created before 1 Jun 2026, the issue due date, or the issue created date + 4 days when no due date is set; for issues created from 1 Jun 2026, the Pipedrive won date. won_clients_master falls back to the won date when no Jira start exists and labels it 'Pipedrive Fallback'; fallback dates are not confirmed starts and are excluded from starts and cohorts.

reasons.early: 2024 Jira records are incomplete: 73 of 88 deals won in 2024 have a Jira issue (2025: 257 of 269), so 2024 starts and contracts are undercounted.
reasons.rule: The start date rule changed on 1 Jun 2026: from June a start is the won date, before it the kickoff date (a median 5 days later), so starts from June are not counted the same way as earlier months.
reasons.ucgap: 46 of the 86 clients who closed from August to December 2025 have no Under Contract date, so the contract counts for June to November 2025 are too low.
reasons.zero: No events in the comparison period.
